title: Doc Cheatham's visit and Freddy's fate in wartime Holland
summary: Doc Cheatham came to join Freddy just before the war and Briggs told him to go home; Freddy was trapped in Holland and forced by the Germans to care for his family.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years

blocks.x: he made a mistake, and the funniest thing is I told you yesterday, that Doc Cheatham, came over, three days before World War II was declared.
Doc Cheatham came over, passing France for through Holland to join Freddy, you see.
Well, just to follow that out a little bit, Freddy went back during the war, I mean right before the war.
No, no. Freddy was caught in Germany, and in Holland.
Well, Doc turned around and got right out of there, didn't he?
Oh, yes, I told the Doc, I went down to see him. He phoned and went down to see him, and I said, 'You get
the first boat back to where you came from." And he went back.
Freddy was a -- Freddy had a lot of -- I heard that Freddy had a lot of trouble in Holland, 'cause he had his wife and two children with him, two daughters, and apparently he had neglected them.

And his wife -- the Germans were already in Holland, but America was not at war, and his wife went to the police station, to the police, and she told them, that Freddy had disbanded them. You know, he didn't take her.
And, apparently, the Germans forced him to take care of his wife and children. And -- I don't know how that happened.
